title_ar: "غزة مسؤولية إسلامية وإنسانية"  مؤتمر دولي ينظمه الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين ووقف علماء الإسلام بتركيا
title_en: "Gaza Is an Islamic and Human Responsibility" — An International Conference Organised by the International Union of Muslim Scholars and the Endowment of the Scholars of Islam in Turkey
body_ar:
انطلق ظهر اليوم ـ الجمعة ـ بمدينة استطنبول التركية مؤتمر "غزة مسؤولية إسلامية وإنسانية " الذي ينظمه وقف علماء الإسلام في تركيا والاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين وبمشاركة شخصيات علمية وفكرية من مختلف دول العالم .

وقد أعلن المشرفون على المؤتمر انطلاقة أنشطته في مؤتمر صحفي ـ من ساحة مسجد الصحابي الجليل أبي أيوب الأنصاري رضي الله عنه في اسطنبول ـ خصص لقراءة بيان العلماء و المشاركين حضرته الجهات المنظمة وجمع غفير من المصلين .

ويهدف هذا المؤتمر إلى تحشيد الأمة الإسلامية والإنسانية لإيقاف العدوان الصهيوني، وفتح الممرات، وإيصال جميع ما يحتاجه المرابطون الصابرونه في غزة، وتحقيق تحالف إسلامي لمنع الإبادة الجماعية والحيلولة دون تحقيق أهداف المشروع الصهيوني الرامي إلى تهجير سكان غزة وتشريدهم ، كما يهدف المشاركون إلى تشكيل حلف فضول إنساني لنصرة المستضعفين وأصحاب القضايا العادلة ولمنع انتهاكات حقوق الإنسان ولملاحقة المجرمين ومعاقبتهم .

ولإنجاح المؤتمر والاستفادة من جميع المشاركين فيه، وزع المنظمون الحضور إلى ورشات مختصة للمناقشة والتفاعل وتبادل الخبرات و الاستفادة من الجميع؛

ويستمر المؤتمر مدة أسبوع تتضمن أنشطته مجموعة من الورشات ولقاءات علمية وأكاديمية وندوات تنعشها نخبة من المفكرين وأصحاب الفضيلة والمختصين.

ويأتي هذا المؤتمر في وقت زادت فيه آلة الحرب الصهيونية والقوى الداعمة لها من استهداف المدنين في غزة وتجويعهم في صمت عالمي وتصامم عربي إسلامي.
body_en:
At midday today — Friday — in the Turkish city of Istanbul, the conference "Gaza Is an Islamic and Human Responsibility" got under way, organised by the Endowment of the Scholars of Islam in Turkey and the International Union of Muslim Scholars, with the participation of scholarly and intellectual figures from various countries of the world.

Those overseeing the conference announced the launch of its activities at a press conference — from the courtyard of the mosque of the noble Companion Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, may God be pleased with him, in Istanbul — set aside for the reading of the statement of the scholars and the participants, attended by the organising bodies and a great throng of worshippers.

This conference aims to mobilise the Islamic and the human community to stop the Zionist aggression, to open the crossings, and to deliver everything the steadfast people holding the frontier in Gaza need; and to bring about an Islamic alliance to prevent the genocide and to stand in the way of the aims of the Zionist project, which seeks to displace and scatter the people of Gaza. The participants also aim to form a humanitarian pact of chivalry to come to the aid of the oppressed and of those with just causes, to prevent violations of human rights, and to pursue the criminals and see them punished.

So as to make the conference a success and to benefit from all those taking part in it, the organisers distributed those attending into specialised workshops for discussion, for interaction, for the exchange of expertise and for benefiting from everyone;

The conference continues for a week, its activities taking in a set of workshops, scholarly and academic meetings and seminars enlivened by a select group of thinkers, of men of eminence and of specialists.

This conference comes at a time when the Zionist war machine and the powers backing it have increased their targeting of civilians in Gaza and their starving of them, amid a global silence and an Arab and Islamic feigning of deafness.

flags.context: one of the stated aims of the conference
options: a modern-day League of the Virtuous for humanitarian ends
flags.note: Ḥilf al-Fuḍūl was the pre-Islamic pact at Mecca to come to the aid of the wronged, which the Prophet later said he would answer if called to its like. The Arabic invokes it as a model, and any English rendering must choose between naming the historical pact and conveying what it stood for. 'Pact of chivalry' conveys the sense but loses the allusion; option 1 keeps the allusion but is opaque. Needs a decision by the Sheikh's office.

flags.context: one of the two organising bodies
options: the Endowment of the Scholars of Islam in Turkey
the Waqf of the Scholars of Islam in Turkey
the Islamic Scholars Foundation of Turkey
flags.note: waqf is 'endowment' in the glossary, and the body is a Turkish vakıf. It may well have a registered English or Turkish name of its own, which should override this rendering; flagged for that reason rather than because the Arabic is unclear.

flags.context: those the conference aims to supply
options: the steadfast people holding the frontier in Gaza
the patient ones stationed in Gaza
flags.note: The source reads الصابرونه, with a stray final hāʾ on الصابرون. This is a source defect, preserved in body_ar and not corrected, per style guide section 11. The translation reads it as الصابرون.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk. Sheikh al-Dedew is not named anywhere in this record; the site files it under his name because he sits on the board of trustees of one of the organising bodies, which the record itself does not say. The site should not present it as a text of his.
The body uses the tatweel character as a dash three times; preserved in body_ar and rendered as an em dash in body_en.
استطنبول in the first line is the source's misspelling of اسطنبول, which the same record spells correctly two lines later. Preserved and not corrected.
المدنين in the last line is the source's spelling of المدنيين, 'civilians'. Preserved and not corrected.
تصامم is a deliberate feigning of deafness, not mere silence, and is distinguished in the English from صمت in the same sentence.
editorial_review_reasons: The record reports a conference whose stated aims include preventing 'the genocide' and pursuing and punishing 'the criminals', and it characterises a named state's conduct in strong terms throughout. Published in English this is politically charged material bearing on an active armed conflict and on possible criminal liability of identified parties, with reputational and potentially legal exposure in Western jurisdictions. It is additionally filed under the Sheikh's name although he is not mentioned in it. Translated faithfully; the publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.
